This is used to guide the development of an advanced benchmarking framework for quantum computers designed to evaluate the trade-off between run-time execution performance and the solution quality for iterative hybrid quantum-classical applications. The framework generates performance profiles through compelling visualizations that show performance progression as a function of time for various problem sizes and illustrates algorithm limitations uncovered by the benchmarking approach. As an illustration, we explore the factors that influence quantum computing system throughput, using results obtained through execution on various quantum simulators and quantum hardware systems.

papers.title: Mixed-integer linear programming solver using Benders decomposition assisted by a neutral-atom quantum processor
papers.titleZh: 中性原子量子处理器辅助的Benders分解混合整数规划求解
papers.summaryZh: 论文提出经典-量子混合MILP求解:用Benders分解将问题拆分,主问题经自动QUBO转换后交由中性原子处理器(_pasqal_)求解。该方法收紧了连续变量上界并降低迭代数,展示了中性原子阵列在通用数学规划求解器中的嵌入方式。
papers.abstract: This paper presents a hybrid classical-quantum approach to solve mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) using neutral-atom quantum computations. We apply Benders decomposition (BD) to segment MILPs into a master problem (MP) and a subproblem, where the MP is addressed using a neutral-atom device, after being transformed into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model, with an automatized procedure. Our MILP to QUBO conversion tightens the upper bounds of the continuous variables involved, positively impacting the required qubit count, and the convergence of the algorithm. To solve the QUBO, we develop a heuristic for atom register embedding and apply a variational algorithm for pulse shaping. In addition, we implement a proof of concept that outperforms existing solutions. We also conduct preliminary numerical results: In a series of small MILP instances our algorithm identifies over 95% of feasible solutions of high quality, outperforming classical BD approaches where the MP is solved using simulated annealing.

papers.title: The effect of classical optimizers and Ansatz depth on QAOA performance in noisy devices
papers.titleZh: 含噪设备上经典优化器与Ansatz深度对QAOA性能的影响
papers.summaryZh: Petruccione团队系统实验了现实噪声下经典优化器选择与电路深度对QAOA表现的影响,发现噪声改变了优化器相对优劣与最优深度,深度并非越深越好。该研究为在真实硬件上配置QAOA的"优化器-深度"组合提供了实用指南。
papers.abstract: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a variational quantum algorithm for Near-term Intermediate-Scale Quantum computers (NISQ) providing approximate solutions for combinatorial optimization problems. The QAOA utilizes a quantum-classical loop, consisting of a quantum ansatz and a classical optimizer, to minimize some cost function, computed on the quantum device. This paper presents an investigation into the impact of realistic noise on the classical optimizer and the determination of optimal circuit depth for the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) in the presence of noise. We find that, while there is no significant difference in the performance of classical optimizers in a state vector simulation, the Adam and AMSGrad optimizers perform best in the presence of shot noise. Under the conditions of real noise, the SPSA optimizer, along with ADAM and AMSGrad, emerge as the top performers. The study also reveals that the quality of solutions to some 5 qubit minimum vertex cover problems increases for up to around six layers in the QAOA circuit, after which it begins to decline. This analysis shows that increasing the number of layers in the QAOA in an attempt to increase accuracy may not work well in a noisy device.

papers.title: Robust and fast microwave-driven quantum logic for trapped-ion qubits
papers.titleZh: 面向离子阱量子比特的鲁棒快速微波驱动量子逻辑
papers.summaryZh: 激光控制是离子阱扩展的瓶颈,微波驱动是替代路线。论文在25K低温表面阱中对43Ca+超精细量子比特实现Mølmer–Sørensen双比特门:154微秒门错误率1.0%,331微秒门错误率0.5%,接近激光门水平并配合沃尔什调制动态解耦抑制误差。更低的控制开销有利于优化算法所需的大规模离子阱系统。
papers.abstract: Microwave-driven logic is a promising alternative to laser control in scaling trapped-ion based quantum processors. We implement Mølmer-Sørensen two-qubit gates on 43 Ca + hyperfine clock qubits in a cryogenic ( ≈ 25 K ) surface trap, driven by near-field microwaves. We achieve gate durations of 154 µs [with 1.0(2)% error] and 331 µs [0.5(1)% error], which approaches the performance of typical laser-driven gates. In the 331 µs gate, we demonstrate a Walsh-modulated dynamical decoupling scheme which suppresses errors due to fluctuations in the qubit frequency as well as imperfections in the decoupling drive itself. Published by the American Physical Society 2024

papers.title: On the practical usefulness of the Hardware Efficient Ansatz
papers.titleZh: 论硬件高效Ansatz的实际有用性
papers.summaryZh: 硬件高效Ansatz(HEA)使用原生门与连接以降低噪声影响,但深层时受贫瘠高原困扰、浅层时又能避免,评价长期存在分歧。Cerezo团队给出系统分析:明确HEA在何种任务/数据/深度组合下真正有用、何时注定失败,为变分量子优化中ansatz的选择提供了理论依据。
papers.abstract: Variational Quantum Algorithms (VQAs) and Quantum Machine Learning (QML) models train a parametrized quantum circuit to solve a given learning task. The success of these algorithms greatly hinges on appropriately choosing an ansatz for the quantum circuit. Perhaps one of the most famous ansatzes is the one-dimensional layered Hardware Efficient Ansatz (HEA), which seeks to minimize the effect of hardware noise by using native gates and connectives. The use of this HEA has generated a certain ambivalence arising from the fact that while it suffers from barren plateaus at long depths, it can also avoid them at shallow ones. In this work, we attempt to determine whether one should, or should not, use a HEA. We rigorously identify scenarios where shallow HEAs should likely be avoided (e.g., VQA or QML tasks with data satisfying a volume law of entanglement). More importantly, we identify a Goldilocks scenario where shallow HEAs could achieve a quantum speedup: QML tasks with data satisfying an area law of entanglement. We provide examples for such scenario (such as Gaussian diagonal ensemble random Hamiltonian discrimination), and we show that in these cases a shallow HEA is always trainable and that there exists an anti-concentration of loss function values. Our work highlights the crucial role that input states play in the trainability of a parametrized quantum circuit, a phenomenon that is verified in our numerics.

papers.title: Large Language Models as Evolutionary Optimizers
papers.titleZh: 大语言模型作为进化优化器
papers.summaryZh: Liu、Tang、Ong等人首次系统研究"LLM直接充当进化组合优化器":以自然语言描述问题与父代解,让LLM在提示中执行选择、交叉与变异操作,几乎不需领域知识。在TSP等问题上,配合自适应的自我优化机制,LLM-EA在小规模实例上达到与专门算法可比的质量,揭示了LLM作为通用优化算子的潜力与规模瓶颈。
papers.abstract: Evolutionary algorithms (EAs) have achieved remarkable success in tackling complex combinatorial optimization problems. However, EAs often demand carefully-designed operators with the aid of domain expertise to achieve satisfactory performance. In this work, we present the first study on large language models (LLMs) as evolutionary combinatorial optimizers. The main advantage is that it requires minimal domain knowledge and human efforts, as well as no additional training of the model. This approach is referred to as LLM-driven EA (LMEA). Specifically, in each generation of the evolutionary search, LMEA instructs the LLM to select parent solutions from current population, and perform crossover and mutation to generate offspring solutions. Then, LMEA evaluates these new solutions and include them into the population for the next generation. LMEA is equipped with a self-adaptation mechanism that controls the temperature of the LLM. This enables it to balance between exploration and exploitation and prevents the search from getting stuck in local optima. We investigate the power of LMEA on the classical traveling salesman problems (TSPs) widely used in combinatorial optimization research. Notably, the results show that LMEA performs competitively to traditional heuristics in finding high-quality solutions on TSP instances with up to 20 nodes. Additionally, we also study the effectiveness of LLM-driven crossover/mutation and the self- adaptation mechanism in evolutionary search.

papers.title: Integrating quantum and classical computing for multi-energy system optimization using Benders decomposition
papers.titleZh: 量子与经典计算结合的多元能源系统优化:Benders分解方法
papers.summaryZh: 多元能源系统优化含整数与连续变量,无法直接用量子退火求解。论文提出量子-经典Benders分解框架:以D-Wave求解QUBO型主问题,经典求解器处理子问题,在真实能源系统案例上验证可行性。该模式为含连续变量的工业优化问题提供了量子化入口。
papers.abstract: During recent years, quantum computers have received increasing attention, primarily due to their ability to significantly increase computational performance for specific problems. Computational performance could be improved for mathematical optimization by quantum annealers. This special type of quantum computer can solve quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problems. However, multi-energy systems optimization commonly involves integer and continuous decision variables. Due to their mixed-integer problem structure, quantum annealers cannot be directly used for multi-energy system optimization. To solve multi-energy system optimization problems, we present a hybrid Benders decomposition approach combining optimization on quantum and classical computers. In our approach, the quantum computer solves the master problem, which involves only the integer variables from the original energy system optimization problem. The subproblem includes the continuous variables and is solved by a classical computer. For better performance, we apply improvement techniques to the Benders decomposition. We test the approach on a case study to design a cost-optimal multi-energy system. While we provide a proof of concept that our Benders decomposition approach is applicable for the design of multi-energy systems, the computational time is still higher than for approaches using classical computers only. We therefore estimate the potential improvement of our approach to be expected for larger

papers.title: Variational Quantum Algorithms for Semidefinite Programming
papers.titleZh: 求解半定规划的变分量子算法
papers.summaryZh: 半定规划在运筹与组合优化中至关重要。Patel、Coles与Wilde提出近似求解SDP的变分量子算法,对弱约束类(N≫M)给出收敛到近似局部最优的严格分析,并给出适用于更一般SDP的算法。这为组合优化的凸松弛环节提供了量子化路径。
papers.abstract: A semidefinite program (SDP) is a particular kind of convex optimization problem with applications in operations research, combinatorial optimization, quantum information science, and beyond. In this work, we propose variational quantum algorithms for approximately solving SDPs. For one class of SDPs, we provide a rigorous analysis of their convergence to approximate locally optimal solutions, under the assumption that they are weakly constrained (i.e., N ≫ M , where N is the dimension of the input matrices and M is the number of constraints). We also provide algorithms for a more general class of SDPs that requires fewer assumptions. Finally, we numerically simulate our quantum algorithms for applications such as MaxCut, and the results of these simulations provide evidence that convergence still occurs in noisy settings.

papers.title: Towards Adiabatic Quantum Computing Using Compressed Quantum Circuits
papers.titleZh: 使用压缩量子线路迈向绝热量子计算
papers.summaryZh: Quantinuum团队用张量网络算法优化绝热量子计算的量子线路:将反绝热驱动纳入优化,以变分矩阵乘积算符表示绝热规范势,并经典优化固定深度的参数化电路同时捕获绝热演化与反绝热修正,显著压缩了传统Trotter分解的电路深度,为门型设备上的绝热优化提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract: We describe tensor network algorithms to optimize quantum circuits for adiabatic quantum computing. To suppress diabatic transitions, we include counterdiabatic driving in the optimization and utilize variational matrix product operators to represent adiabatic gauge potentials. Traditionally, Trotter product formulas are used to turn adiabatic time evolution into quantum circuits and the addition of counterdiabatic driving increases the circuit depth per time step. Instead, we classically optimize a parameterized quantum circuit of fixed depth to simultaneously capture adiabatic evolution together with counterdiabatic driving over many time steps. The methods are applied to the ground-state preparation of quantum Ising chains with transverse and longitudinal fields. We show that the classically optimized circuits can significantly outperform Trotter product formulas. Additionally, we discuss how the approach can be used for combinatorial optimization. Published by the American Physical Society 2024

papers.title: Efficient qudit based scheme for photonic quantum computing
papers.titleZh: 基于量子比特(qudit)的高效光量子计算方案
papers.summaryZh: 光子系统天然支持单光子多模式的高维量子态(qudit)。论文研究基于光子数态的qudit方案,构造局部最优的非确定性多qudit门并级联放大成功率。高维编码可减少资源开销,为光量子平台执行优化与模拟算法提供了新资源模型。
papers.abstract: Linear optics is a promising alternative for the realization of quantum computation protocols due to the recent advancements in integrated photonic technology. In this context, usually qubit based quantum circuits are considered, however, photonic systems naturally allow also for d-ary, i.e., qudit based, algorithms. This work investigates qudits defined by the possible photon number states of a single photon in d > 2 optical modes. We demonstrate how to construct locally optimal non-deterministic many-qudit gates using linear optics and photon number resolving detectors, and explore the use of qudit cluster states in the context of a d-ary optimization problem. We find that the qudit cluster states require less optical modes and are encoded by a fewer number of entangled photons than the qubit cluster states with similar computational capabilities. We illustrate the benefit of our qudit scheme by applying it to the k-coloring problem.

papers.title: Solving the vehicle routing problem via quantum support vector machines
papers.titleZh: 经由量子支持向量机求解车辆路径问题
papers.summaryZh: 论文将车辆路径问题(VRP)转化为分类任务,用量子支持向量机与量子核方法求解VRP变体,并与经典基线对比。作为Quantum Machine Intelligence上的研究,它展示了量子机器学习(而非变分优化)路线求解组合问题的新颖尝试。
papers.abstract: Abstract The vehicle routing problem (VRP) is an example of a combinatorial optimization problem that has attracted academic attention due to its potential use in various contexts. VRP aims to arrange vehicle deliveries to several sites in the most efficient and economical manner possible. Quantum machine learning offers a new way to obtain solutions by harnessing the natural speedups of quantum effects, although many solutions and methodologies are modified using classical tools to provide excellent approximations of the VRP. In this paper, we employ 6 and 12 qubit circuits, respectively, to build and evaluate a hybrid quantum machine learning approach for solving VRP of 3- and 4-city scenarios. The approach employs quantum support vector machines (QSVMs) trained using a variational quantum eigensolver on a static or dynamic ansatz. Different encoding strategies are used in the experiment to transform the VRP formulation into a QSVM and solve it. Multiple optimizers from the IBM Qiskit framework are also evaluated and compared

papers.title: Evidence of scaling advantage for the quantum approximate optimization algorithm on a classically intractable problem
papers.titleZh: QAOA在经典难解问题上具有规模优势的证据
papers.summaryZh: JPMorgan团队在Science Advances的重量级工作:对经典上即使中等规模也难解的低自相关二元序列(LABS)问题,进行了高达40比特的无噪声QAOA大规模数值研究,发现固定参数QAOA的运行时间标度优于最先进的分支定界精确求解器,并在Quantinuum离子阱硬件上完成验证。这是迄今关于QAOA规模优势最具影响力的实证之一。
papers.abstract: The quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) is a leading candidate algorithm for solving optimization problems on quantum computers. However, the potential of QAOA to tackle classically intractable problems remains unclear. Here, we perform an extensive numerical investigation of QAOA on the low autocorrelation binary sequences (LABS) problem, which is classically intractable even for moderately sized instances. We perform noiseless simulations with up to 40 qubits and observe that the runtime of QAOA with fixed parameters scales better than branch-and-bound solvers, which are the state-of-the-art exact solvers for LABS. The combination of QAOA with quantum minimum finding gives the best empirical scaling of any algorithm for the LABS problem. We demonstrate experimental progress in executing QAOA for the LABS problem using an algorithm-specific error detection scheme on Quantinuum trapped-ion processors. Our results provide evidence for the utility of QAOA as an algorithmic component that enables quantum speedups.

papers.title: Qubit Efficient Quantum Algorithms for the Vehicle Routing Problem on Noisy Intermediate‐Scale Quantum Processors
papers.titleZh: 含噪中间规模量子处理器上求解车辆路径问题的比特高效量子算法
papers.summaryZh: 针对带时间窗车辆路径问题(VRPTW),论文采用比特高效编码方案大幅压缩所需量子比特数,在11至3964条路径的测试集上评估变分方法在NISQ设备上的表现。该工作直面"真实物流规模 vs 量子比特预算"的矛盾,给出了系统的资源-精度权衡分析。
papers.abstract: Abstract The vehicle routing problem with time windows (VRPTW) is a common optimization problem faced within the logistics industry. In this work, the use of a previously‐introduced qubit encoding scheme is explored to reduce the number of qubits, to evaluate the effectiveness of Noisy Intermediate‐Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices when applied to industry relevant optimization problems. A quantum variational approach is applied to a testbed of multiple VRPTW instances ranging from 11 to 3964 routes. These intances are formulated as quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problems based on realistic shipping scenarios. The results are compared with standard binary‐to‐qubit mappings after executing on simulators as well as various quantum hardware platforms, including IBMQ, AWS (Rigetti), and IonQ. These results are benchmarked against the classical solver, Gurobi. The approach can find approximate solutions to the VRPTW comparable to those obtained from quantum algorithms using the full encoding, despite the reduction in qubits required. These results suggest that using the encoding scheme to fit larger problem sizes into fewer qubits is a promising step in using NISQ devices to find approximate solutions for industry‐based optimization problems, although additional resources are still required to eke out the performance from larger problem sizes.

papers.title: A review on Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm and its variants
papers.titleZh: 量子近似优化算法及其变体综述
papers.summaryZh: Physics Reports上的这篇长篇综述系统整理了QAOA自2014年以来的全部演进:标准QAOA的理论性能与局限,以及多角度QAOA、ADAPT-QAOA、温启动、递归QAOA、约束保持混合器、反绝热QAOA等数十种变体的动机、结构与实证表现,并总结了参数优化策略与硬件实验进展。它是QAOA方向最全面的"变体地图"。

papers.title: Evolution of Heuristics: Towards Efficient Automatic Algorithm Design Using Large Language Model
papers.titleZh: 启发式进化(EoH):基于大语言模型的高效自动算法设计
papers.summaryZh: Liu等人提出EoH,将LLM与进化计算结合进行自动启发式设计(AHD):同时进化"思想"(自然语言描述)与"代码"两种表示,通过精心设计的LLM提示策略实现交叉与变异。在在线装箱、TSP、流水车间调度等问题上,EoH以远低于FunSearch的查询次数设计出超越人工与既有自动方法的启发式,是LLM4CO方向最具影响力的框架之一。
papers.abstract: Heuristics are widely used for dealing with complex search and optimization problems. However, manual design of heuristics can be often very labour extensive and requires rich working experience and knowledge. This paper proposes Evolution of Heuristic (EoH), a novel evolutionary paradigm that leverages both Large Language Models (LLMs) and Evolutionary Computation (EC) methods for Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD). EoH represents the ideas of heuristics in natural language, termed thoughts. They are then translated into executable codes by LLMs. The evolution of both thoughts and codes in an evolutionary search framework makes it very effective and efficient for generating high-performance heuristics. Experiments on three widely studied combinatorial optimization benchmark problems demonstrate that EoH outperforms commonly used handcrafted heuristics and other recent AHD methods including FunSearch. Particularly, the heuristic produced by EoH with a low computational budget (in terms of the number of queries to LLMs) significantly outperforms widely-used human hand-crafted baseline algorithms for the online bin packing problem.

papers.title: Targeted Branching for the Maximum Independent Set Problem Using Graph Neural Networks
papers.titleZh: 使用图神经网络进行最大独立集问题的定向分支
papers.summaryZh: 分支归约(branch-and-reduce)是精确求解最大独立集的最有效方法之一。该工作用图神经网络学习分支决策——预测哪些顶点更可能属于最优解,以定向引导分支,在真实世界大规模实例上显著加速精确求解。这是"学习增强精确算法"这一ML4CO路线的代表性成果。
papers.abstract: Identifying a maximum independent set is a fundamental NP-hard problem. This problem has several real-world applications and requires finding the largest possible set of vertices not adjacent to each other in an undirected graph. Over the past few years, branch-and-bound and branch-and-reduce algorithms have emerged as some of the most effective methods for solving the problem exactly. Specifically, the branch-and-reduce approach, which combines branch-and-bound principles with reduction rules, has proven particularly successful in tackling previously unmanageable real-world instances. This progress was largely made possible by the development of more effective reduction rules. Nevertheless, other key components that can impact the efficiency of these algorithms have not received the same level of interest. Among these is the branching strategy, which determines which vertex to branch on next. Until recently, the most widely used strategy was to choose the vertex of the highest degree. In this work, we present a graph neural network approach for selecting the next branching vertex. The intricate nature of current branch-and-bound solvers makes supervised and reinforcement learning difficult. Therefore, we use a population-based genetic algorithm to evolve the model’s parameters instead. Our proposed approach results in a speedup on 73% of the benchmark instances with a median speedup of 24%.

papers.title: ReEvo: Large Language Models as Hyper-Heuristics with Reflective Evolution
papers.titleZh: ReEvo:具备反思进化能力的大语言模型超启发式
papers.summaryZh: Ye等人提出ReEvo,把LLM定位为"超启发式"——在启发式空间中搜索的生成器,并引入受强化学习启发的"反思"机制:LLM对比父代启发式的表现生成语言化反馈,指导下一代生成,使搜索具备可解释的方向性。ReEvo在TSP、CVRP、装箱、MKP等问题及ACO/引导局部搜索等多种算法框架下达到当前最优,代码开源、影响广泛。

papers.title: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models
papers.titleZh: 用大语言模型进行程序搜索的数学发现(FunSearch)
papers.summaryZh: DeepMind在Nature发表的FunSearch将预训练LLM与进化式程序搜索结合:LLM生成候选程序,自动评估器打分筛选,迭代进化。它在cap set问题上发现了超越已知最优的新构造,并为在线装箱问题找到了优于传统启发式的算法——首次证明LLM可以在开放数学与组合优化问题上产生可验证的新知识,开启了"LLM自动设计启发式算法"这一爆发性方向。
papers.abstract: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated tremendous capabilities in solving complex tasks, from quantitative reasoning to understanding natural language. However, LLMs sometimes suffer from confabulations (or hallucinations), which can result in them making plausible but incorrect statements 1,2 . This hinders the use of current large models in scientific discovery. Here we introduce FunSearch (short for searching in the function space), an evolutionary procedure based on pairing a pretrained LLM with a systematic evaluator. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach to surpass the best-known results in important problems, pushing the boundary of existing LLM-based approaches 3 . Applying FunSearch to a central problem in extremal combinatorics—the cap set problem—we discover new constructions of large cap sets going beyond the best-known ones, both in finite dimensional and asymptotic cases. This shows that it is possible to make discoveries for established open problems using LLMs. We showcase the generality of FunSearch by applying it to an algorithmic problem, online bin packing, finding new heuristics that improve on widely used baselines. In contrast to most computer search approaches, FunSearch searches for programs that describe how to solve a problem, rather than what the solution is. Beyond being an effective and scalable strategy, discovered programs tend to be more interpretable than raw solutions, enabling feedback loops between domain exper

papers.title: Algorithm Evolution Using Large Language Model
papers.titleZh: 使用大语言模型的算法进化(AEL)
papers.summaryZh: AEL是EoH的前身工作:提出用LLM在进化框架中自动生成与改进优化算法,以TSP的构造式启发式为案例,展示LLM生成的算法可超越人工设计的贪心规则并具备跨规模泛化能力。该论文确立了"算法本身作为进化个体、LLM作为遗传算子"的基本范式。
papers.abstract: Optimization can be found in many real-life applications. Designing an effective algorithm for a specific optimization problem typically requires a tedious amount of effort from human experts with domain knowledge and algorithm design skills. In this paper, we propose a novel approach called Algorithm Evolution using Large Language Model (AEL). It utilizes a large language model (LLM) to automatically generate optimization algorithms via an evolutionary framework. AEL does algorithm-level evolution without model training. Human effort and requirements for domain knowledge can be significantly reduced. We take constructive methods for the salesman traveling problem as a test example, we show that the constructive algorithm obtained by AEL outperforms simple hand-crafted and LLM-generated heuristics. Compared with other domain deep learning model-based algorithms, these methods exhibit excellent scalability across different problem sizes. AEL is also very different from previous attempts that utilize LLMs as search operators in algorithms.

papers.title: Quantum-enhanced Markov chain Monte Carlo
papers.titleZh: 量子增强的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛
papers.summaryZh: IBM团队在Nature提出量子增强MCMC:用量子计算机生成Ising模型玻尔兹曼分布采样的提议(proposal),再由经典Metropolis-Hastings步骤保证正确性。在27量子比特超导处理器上,该混合算法在低温自旋玻璃采样上收敛速度比经典提议快约3.6至100倍,且对噪声具有内在鲁棒性。这是"量子做提议、经典做接受"混合范式的代表,与组合优化中的采样类方法直接相关。

papers.title: Quantum annealing for industry applications: introduction and review
papers.titleZh: 量子退火的工业应用:引论与综述
papers.summaryZh: Yarkoni等人在Reports on Progress in Physics上系统综述了量子退火在工业场景的应用现状:从D-Wave处理器的原理与编程模型,到物流、调度、金融、材料等领域的案例与性能评估,并客观讨论了嵌入开销、噪声与"量子优势"证据的争议。这是理解退火路线产业落地的必读文献。
papers.abstract: Quantum annealing (QA) is a heuristic quantum optimization algorithm that can be used to solve combinatorial optimization problems. In recent years, advances in quantum technologies have enabled the development of small- and intermediate-scale quantum processors that implement the QA algorithm for programmable use. Specifically, QA processors produced by D-Wave systems have been studied and tested extensively in both research and industrial settings across different disciplines. In this paper we provide a literature review of the theoretical motivations for QA as a heuristic quantum optimization algorithm, the software and hardware that is required to use such quantum processors, and the state-of-the-art applications and proofs-of-concepts that have been demonstrated using them. The goal of our review is to provide a centralized and condensed source regarding applications of QA technology. We identify the advantages, limitations, and potential of QA for both researchers and practitioners from various fields.

papers.title: Quantum optimization of maximum independent set using Rydberg atom arrays
papers.titleZh: 利用里德堡原子阵列进行最大独立集的量子优化
papers.summaryZh: 哈佛/QuEra团队在Science上的里程碑实验:用最多289个二维里德堡原子量子比特,借助里德堡阻塞的硬件高效编码求解最大独立集问题,实现闭环变分优化,并在最难实例上观察到相对模拟退火的超线性量子加速迹象。这是中性原子平台在组合优化上最具影响力的实验证据,催生了此后大量的MIS量子优化研究。
papers.abstract: Realizing quantum speedup for practically relevant, computationally hard problems is a central challenge in quantum information science. Using Rydberg atom arrays with up to 289 qubits in two spatial dimensions, we experimentally investigate quantum algorithms for solving the maximum independent set problem. We use a hardware-efficient encoding associated with Rydberg blockade, realize closed-loop optimization to test several variational algorithms, and subsequently apply them to systematically explore a class of graphs with programmable connectivity. We find that the problem hardness is controlled by the solution degeneracy and number of local minima, and we experimentally benchmark the quantum algorithm's performance against classical simulated annealing. On the hardest graphs, we observe a superlinear quantum speedup in finding exact solutions in the deep circuit regime and analyze its origins.

papers.title: Noisy intermediate-scale quantum algorithms
papers.titleZh: 含噪中等规模量子(NISQ)算法
papers.summaryZh: Reviews of Modern Physics上的NISQ时代纲领性综述,系统覆盖变分量子算法的通用框架、多体物理与化学模拟、组合优化(QAOA与量子退火)以及量子机器学习,并深入讨论贫瘠高原、噪声影响与误差缓解等核心挑战。它是理解"近期量子计算能做什么"的标准入门文献,被引超过1700次。
papers.abstract: Noisy quantum computers can in principle perform reliable quantum computations, but truly scalable systems require noise levels lower than are presently achieved. Still, moderate-complexity computations can be performed. This review discusses what is possible in this ``noisy intermediate scale'' quantum (NISQ) era. Topic areas include the simulation of many-body physics and chemistry, combinatorial optimization, and machine learning. It is evident that the NISQ era has produced new paradigms for programming that will be built upon as quantum computers are further perfected.

papers.title: Variational quantum algorithms
papers.titleZh: 变分量子算法
papers.summaryZh: Cerezo等人在Nature Reviews Physics上的这篇综述是变分量子算法(VQA)领域的标准参考文献(被引超3000次):系统阐述VQA的通用结构——参数化量子电路、代价函数、经典优化器、ansatz设计,覆盖VQE、QAOA、量子机器学习等应用,并深入讨论贫瘠高原、噪声与测量开销等核心挑战。任何进入QAOA/VQA研究的读者都应从这里开始。

papers.title: Warm-starting quantum optimization
papers.titleZh: 温启动量子优化
papers.summaryZh: IBM的Egger、Mareček与Woerner提出"温启动"QAOA:先用经典松弛(如半定规划或连续松弛)得到高质量近似解,再据此构造初始态与调整后的混合器,使量子算法从经典最优邻域出发而非均匀叠加态。理论上继承了经典松弛的近似比保证,实践中显著提升低深度QAOA的解质量,是量子-经典混合优化的经典范式之一。
papers.abstract: There is an increasing interest in quantum algorithms for problems of integer programming and combinatorial optimization. Classical solvers for such problems employ relaxations, which replace binary variables with continuous ones, for instance in the form of higher-dimensional matrix-valued problems (semidefinite programming). Under the Unique Games Conjecture, these relaxations often provide the best performance ratios available classically in polynomial time. Here, we discuss how to warm-start quantum optimization with an initial state corresponding to the solution of a relaxation of a combinatorial optimization problem and how to analyze properties of the associated quantum algorithms. In particular, this allows the quantum algorithm to inherit the performance guarantees of the classical algorithm. We illustrate this in the context of portfolio optimization, where our results indicate that warm-starting the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is particularly beneficial at low depth. Likewise, Recursive QAOA for MAXCUT problems shows a systematic increase in the size of the obtained cut for fully connected graphs with random weights, when Goemans-Williamson randomized rounding is utilized in a warm start. It is straightforward to apply the same ideas to other randomized-rounding schemes and optimization problems.

papers.title: Quantum approximate optimization of non-planar graph problems on a planar superconducting processor
papers.titleZh: 在平面超导处理器上对非平面图问题进行量子近似优化
papers.summaryZh: Google量子AI团队在Sycamore超导处理器上实现了迄今最系统的QAOA硬件实验之一:在硬件原生图、以及需要路由编译的非平面图问题(Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型、3正则MaxCut)上运行深度p≤5的QAOA,研究了噪声与编译开销对性能的影响。实验揭示了当前硬件在非原生连接问题上的显著性能衰减,为量子优化的实用化设定了现实基准。

papers.title: Machine learning for combinatorial optimization: A methodological tour d'horizon
papers.titleZh: 机器学习求解组合优化:方法论全景综述
papers.summaryZh: Bengio、Lodi与Prouvost在EJOR上的这篇综述是ML4CO领域的奠基性文献:系统梳理机器学习与运筹学两个社区用学习替代手工启发式决策的尝试,提出"端到端学习""学习配置算法""学习与算法交替"三种集成范式的方法论框架,并指明了泛化、可扩展与理论保证等开放问题,至今仍是该方向的引用基石。
papers.abstract: This paper surveys the recent attempts, both from the machine learning and operations research communities, at leveraging machine learning to solve combinatorial optimization problems. Given the hard nature of these problems, state-of-the-art algorithms rely on handcrafted heuristics for making decisions that are otherwise too expensive to compute or mathematically not well defined. Thus, machine learning looks like a natural candidate to make such decisions in a more principled and optimized way. We advocate for pushing further the integration of machine learning and combinatorial optimization and detail a methodology to do so. A main point of the paper is seeing generic optimization problems as data points and inquiring what is the relevant distribution of problems to use for learning on a given task.

papers.title: Combinatorial Optimization and Reasoning with Graph Neural Networks
papers.titleZh: 图神经网络的组合优化与推理
papers.summaryZh: Cappart、Chételat、Khalil、Lodi、Morris与Veličković合著的JMLR综述,系统论述图神经网络作为组合优化核心构件的理论与实践:GNN如何表达算法推理、与精确求解器(分支定界)和启发式的多种结合方式、表达力与泛化的理论边界,以及开放问题。这是理解GNN在组合优化中"能做什么、不能做什么"的权威指南。
papers.abstract: Combinatorial optimization is a well-established area in operations research and computer science. Until recently, its methods have mostly focused on solving problem instances in isolation, ignoring the fact that they often stem from related data distributions in practice. However, recent years have seen a surge of interest in using machine learning, especially graph neural networks, as a key building block for combinatorial tasks, either directly as solvers or by enhancing the former. This paper presents a conceptual review of recent key advancements in this emerging field, aiming at researchers in both optimization and machine learning.

papers.title: POMO: Policy Optimization with Multiple Optima for Reinforcement Learning
papers.titleZh: POMO:利用多重最优解的策略优化
papers.summaryZh: Kwon等人观察到组合优化解常有多个等价表示(如TSP路径可从任意城市出发),POMO利用这种对称性:并行从多个起点展开轨迹,以共享基线做REINFORCE训练,并在推理时结合实例增强。该方法显著提升了神经构造式求解器在TSP、CVRP、背包问题上的性能,成为此后神经组合优化的标准训练范式之一。
papers.abstract: In neural combinatorial optimization (CO), reinforcement learning (RL) can turn a deep neural net into a fast, powerful heuristic solver of NP-hard problems. This approach has a great potential in practical applications because it allows near-optimal solutions to be found without expert guides armed with substantial domain knowledge. We introduce Policy Optimization with Multiple Optima (POMO), an end-to-end approach for building such a heuristic solver. POMO is applicable to a wide range of CO problems. It is designed to exploit the symmetries in the representation of a CO solution. POMO uses a modified REINFORCE algorithm that forces diverse rollouts towards all optimal solutions. Empirically, the low-variance baseline of POMO makes RL training fast and stable, and it is more resistant to local minima compared to previous approaches. We also introduce a new augmentation-based inference method, which accompanies POMO nicely. We demonstrate the effectiveness of POMO by solving three popular NP-hard problems, namely, traveling salesman (TSP), capacitated vehicle routing (CVRP), and 0-1 knapsack (KP). For all three, our solver based on POMO shows a significant improvement in performance over all recent learned heuristics. In particular, we achieve the optimality gap of 0.14% with TSP100 while reducing inference time by more than an order of magnitude.

papers.title: Exact Combinatorial Optimization with Graph Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.titleZh: 基于图卷积神经网络的精确组合优化
papers.summaryZh: Gasse等人提出用图卷积网络学习分支定界中的变量选择策略:利用MILP天然的变量-约束二分图表示,通过模仿学习逼近昂贵但高效的强分支规则。学到的策略在多类问题上超越了SCIP默认策略并能泛化到更大实例,开创了"学习增强精确求解器"路线,催生了ML4CO的整个learning-to-branch研究方向与竞赛。
papers.abstract: Combinatorial optimization problems are typically tackled by the branch-and-bound paradigm. We propose a new graph convolutional neural network model for learning branch-and-bound variable selection policies, which leverages the natural variable-constraint bipartite graph representation of mixed-integer linear programs. We train our model via imitation learning from the strong branching expert rule, and demonstrate on a series of hard problems that our approach produces policies that improve upon state-of-the-art machine-learning methods for branching and generalize to instances significantly larger than seen during training. Moreover, we improve for the first time over expert-designed branching rules implemented in a state-of-the-art solver on large problems. Code for reproducing all the experiments can be found at https://github.com/ds4dm/learn2branch.

papers.title: Online Vehicle Routing With Neural Combinatorial Optimization and Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.titleZh: 基于神经组合优化与深度强化学习的在线车辆路径规划
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
papers.summaryZh: 面向实时小件配送的在线车辆路径问题,论文将神经组合优化与深度强化学习结合,训练策略网络在毫秒级生成高质量路径,替代计算耗时的数学规划方法。作为神经组合优化在交通运输领域的早期高被引应用,展示了"离线训练、在线快速推理"范式在动态运筹场景的价值。
papers.abstract: Online vehicle routing is an important task of the modern transportation service provider. Contributed by the ever-increasing real-time demand on the transportation system, especially small-parcel last-mile delivery requests, vehicle route generation is becoming more computationally complex than before. The existing routing algorithms are mostly based on mathematical programming, which requires huge computation time in city-size transportation networks. To develop routes with minimal time, in this paper, we propose a novel deep reinforcement learning-based neural combinatorial optimization strategy. Specifically, we transform the online routing problem to a vehicle tour generation problem, and propose a structural graph embedded pointer network to develop these tours iteratively. Furthermore, since constructing supervised training data for the neural network is impractical due to the high computation complexity, we propose a deep reinforcement learning mechanism with an unsupervised auxiliary network to train the model parameters. A multisampling scheme is also devised to further improve the system performance. Since the parameter training process is offline, the proposed strategy can achieve a superior online route generation speed. To assess the proposed strategy, we conduct comprehensive case studies with a real-world transportation network. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can significantly outperform conventional strategies with limited computation

papers.title: Combinatorial optimization by simulating adiabatic bifurcations in nonlinear Hamiltonian systems
papers.titleZh: 通过模拟非线性哈密顿系统的绝热分叉求解组合优化
papers.summaryZh: 东芝团队提出"模拟分叉"(Simulated Bifurcation)算法:受非线性振子网络量子绝热优化启发,通过模拟经典非线性哈密顿系统的绝热分叉演化求解Ising问题,天然支持大规模并行,在FPGA/GPU上求解2000节点全连接MaxCut比相干Ising机更快。这是量子启发算法在经典硬件上取得工程成功的标志性工作。
papers.abstract: Combinatorial optimization problems are ubiquitous but difficult to solve. Hardware devices for these problems have recently been developed by various approaches, including quantum computers. Inspired by recently proposed quantum adiabatic optimization using a nonlinear oscillator network, we propose a new optimization algorithm simulating adiabatic evolutions of classical nonlinear Hamiltonian systems exhibiting bifurcation phenomena, which we call simulated bifurcation (SB). SB is based on adiabatic and chaotic (ergodic) evolutions of nonlinear Hamiltonian systems. SB is also suitable for parallel computing because of its simultaneous updating. Implementing SB with a field-programmable gate array, we demonstrate that the SB machine can obtain good approximate solutions of an all-to-all connected 2000-node MAX-CUT problem in 0.5 ms, which is about 10 times faster than a state-of-the-art laser-based machine called a coherent Ising machine. SB will accelerate large-scale combinatorial optimization harnessing digital computer technologies and also offer a new application of computational and mathematical physics.

papers.title: Quantum computing for finance: Overview and prospects
papers.titleZh: 量子计算金融:概览与展望
papers.summaryZh: Orús、Mugel与Lizaso的这篇高被引综述系统梳理了量子计算在金融领域的应用路线:量子退火与QAOA用于投资组合优化、套利机会识别、信用评分,以及量子机器学习在金融深度学习中的潜力。金融组合优化是量子优化最早、最活跃的应用方向之一,该文是理解其问题建模的入门参考。
papers.abstract: We discuss how quantum computation can be applied to financial problems, providing an overview of current approaches and potential prospects. We review quantum optimization algorithms, and expose how quantum annealers can be used to optimize portfolios, find arbitrage opportunities, and perform credit scoring. We also discuss deep-learning in finance, and suggestions to improve these methods through quantum machine learning. Finally, we consider quantum amplitude estimation, and how it can result in a quantum speed-up for Monte Carlo sampling. This has direct applications to many current financial methods, including pricing of derivatives and risk analysis. Perspectives are also discussed.

papers.title: From the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm to a Quantum Alternating Operator Ansatz
papers.titleZh: 从量子近似优化算法到量子交替算符Ansatz
papers.summaryZh: Hadfield、Rieffel等人将QAOA推广为"量子交替算符Ansatz"(同样缩写QAOA):混合算符不再局限于横场X,而是可以设计为保持可行子空间的任意算符族,从而原生处理带约束的组合优化问题(如图着色、旅行商、最大k团),无需罚项。该框架奠定了约束保持型量子优化设计的理论基础。
papers.abstract: The next few years will be exciting as prototype universal quantum processors emerge, enabling the implementation of a wider variety of algorithms. Of particular interest are quantum heuristics, which require experimentation on quantum hardware for their evaluation and which have the potential to significantly expand the breadth of applications for which quantum computers have an established advantage. A leading candidate is Farhi et al.’s quantum approximate optimization algorithm, which alternates between applying a cost function based Hamiltonian and a mixing Hamiltonian. Here, we extend this framework to allow alternation between more general families of operators. The essence of this extension, the quantum alternating operator ansatz, is the consideration of general parameterized families of unitaries rather than only those corresponding to the time evolution under a fixed local Hamiltonian for a time specified by the parameter. This ansatz supports the representation of a larger, and potentially more useful, set of states than the original formulation, with potential long-term impact on a broad array of application areas. For cases that call for mixing only within a desired subspace, refocusing on unitaries rather than Hamiltonians enables more efficiently implementable mixers than was possible in the original framework. Such mixers are particularly useful for optimization problems with hard constraints that must always be satisfied, defining a feasible subspace, and so

papers.title: Barren plateaus in quantum neural network training landscapes
papers.titleZh: 量子神经网络训练景观中的贫瘠高原
papers.summaryZh: Google团队2018年的这篇Nature Communications论文首次系统揭示了"贫瘠高原"现象:随机参数化量子电路的梯度随比特数指数消失,使得混合量子-经典算法在超过少数比特后无法有效训练。该发现深刻塑造了此后QAOA/VQA的ansatz设计、参数初始化与可训练性理论研究,是变分量子算法方向被引最高的工作之一。
papers.abstract: Many experimental proposals for noisy intermediate scale quantum devices involve training a parameterized quantum circuit with a classical optimization loop. Such hybrid quantum-classical algorithms are popular for applications in quantum simulation, optimization, and machine learning. Due to its simplicity and hardware efficiency, random circuits are often proposed as initial guesses for exploring the space of quantum states. We show that the exponential dimension of Hilbert space and the gradient estimation complexity make this choice unsuitable for hybrid quantum-classical algorithms run on more than a few qubits. Specifically, we show that for a wide class of reasonable parameterized quantum circuits, the probability that the gradient along any reasonable direction is non-zero to some fixed precision is exponentially small as a function of the number of qubits. We argue that this is related to the 2-design characteristic of random circuits, and that solutions to this problem must be studied.

papers.title: Learning Combinatorial Optimization Algorithms over Graphs
papers.titleZh: 在图上学习组合优化算法
papers.summaryZh: Dai、Khalil等人提出S2V-DQN:用structure2vec图嵌入表示部分解与图结构,以深度Q学习端到端学习MVC、MaxCut、TSP等问题的贪心构造策略,学到的策略可泛化到远大于训练规模的实例。该工作与Bello等人的NCO一起开创了"图神经网络+强化学习"求解组合优化的研究路线,是ML4CO的奠基文献。
papers.abstract: The design of good heuristics or approximation algorithms for NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems often requires significant specialized knowledge and trial-and-error. Can we automate this challenging, tedious process, and learn the algorithms instead? In many real-world applications, it is typically the case that the same optimization problem is solved again and again on a regular basis, maintaining the same problem structure but differing in the data. This provides an opportunity for learning heuristic algorithms that exploit the structure of such recurring problems. In this paper, we propose a unique combination of reinforcement learning and graph embedding to address this challenge. The learned greedy policy behaves like a meta-algorithm that incrementally constructs a solution, and the action is determined by the output of a graph embedding network capturing the current state of the solution. We show that our framework can be applied to a diverse range of optimization problems over graphs, and learns effective algorithms for the Minimum Vertex Cover, Maximum Cut and Traveling Salesman problems.

papers.title: A coherent Ising machine for 2000-node optimization problems
papers.titleZh: 面向2000节点优化问题的相干Ising机
papers.summaryZh: NTT团队在Science上展示了基于简并光参量振荡器与测量反馈耦合的相干Ising机(CIM),突破了物理Ising机在自旋耦合数量上的限制,实现2000自旋全连接MaxCut问题的求解,速度优于模拟退火。CIM作为光学"量子启发"专用求解器,是Ising硬件路线中与量子退火并行的重要分支。
papers.abstract: The analysis and optimization of complex systems can be reduced to mathematical problems collectively known as combinatorial optimization. Many such problems can be mapped onto ground-state search problems of the Ising model, and various artificial spin systems are now emerging as promising approaches. However, physical Ising machines have suffered from limited numbers of spin-spin couplings because of implementations based on localized spins, resulting in severe scalability problems. We report a 2000-spin network with all-to-all spin-spin couplings. Using a measurement and feedback scheme, we coupled time-multiplexed degenerate optical parametric oscillators to implement maximum cut problems on arbitrary graph topologies with up to 2000 nodes. Our coherent Ising machine outperformed simulated annealing in terms of accuracy and computation time for a 2000-node complete graph.

papers.title: The theory of variational hybrid quantum-classical algorithms
papers.titleZh: 变分混合量子-经典算法的理论
papers.summaryZh: McClean、Romero、Babbush与Aspuru-Guzik系统建立了变分量子本征求解器(VQE)的一般理论:提出变分绝热ansatz、探讨酉耦合簇等结构,并给出面向实际实现的算法改进。该工作奠定了"量子设备做态制备与测量、经典计算机做参数优化"这一混合范式的理论基础,是QAOA等所有变分量子优化算法的共同源头之一。
papers.abstract: Many quantum algorithms have daunting resource requirements when compared to what is available today. To address this discrepancy, a quantum-classical hybrid optimization scheme known as 'the quantum variational eigensolver' was developed (Peruzzo et al 2014 Nat. Commun. 5 4213 ) with the philosophy that even minimal quantum resources could be made useful when used in conjunction with classical routines. In this work we extend the general theory of this algorithm and suggest algorithmic improvements for practical implementations. Specifically, we develop a variational adiabatic ansatz and explore unitary coupled cluster where we establish a connection from second order unitary coupled cluster to universal gate sets through a relaxation of exponential operator splitting. We introduce the concept of quantum variational error suppression that allows some errors to be suppressed naturally in this algorithm on a pre-threshold quantum device. Additionally, we analyze truncation and correlated sampling in Hamiltonian averaging as ways to reduce the cost of this procedure. Finally, we show how the use of modern derivative free optimization techniques can offer dramatic computational savings of up to three orders of magnitude over previously used optimization techniques.

papers.title: A Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
papers.titleZh: 量子近似优化算法(QAOA)
papers.summaryZh: Farhi、Goldstone与Gutmann 2014年提出的QAOA是整个量子组合优化领域的起点:算法由整数p参数化,交替施加代价哈密顿量与混合哈密顿量的演化,p越大近似质量越高;电路局域性不超过目标函数的局域性,深度随p线性增长。在MaxCut等问题上给出了p=1的解析性能保证。此后十余年的变分量子优化研究几乎都建立在这一框架之上。
papers.abstract: We introduce a quantum algorithm that produces approximate solutions for combinatorial optimization problems. The algorithm depends on a positive integer p and the quality of the approximation improves as p is increased. The quantum circuit that implements the algorithm consists of unitary gates whose locality is at most the locality of the objective function whose optimum is sought. The depth of the circuit grows linearly with p times (at worst) the number of constraints. If p is fixed, that is, independent of the input size, the algorithm makes use of efficient classical preprocessing. If p grows with the input size a different strategy is proposed. We study the algorithm as applied to MaxCut on regular graphs and analyze its performance on 2-regular and 3-regular graphs for fixed p. For p = 1, on 3-regular graphs the quantum algorithm always finds a cut that is at least 0.6924 times the size of the optimal cut.

papers.title: A variational eigenvalue solver on a photonic quantum processor
papers.titleZh: 光子量子处理器上的变分本征值求解器
papers.summaryZh: Peruzzo等人2014年在光子量子处理器上首次实现变分量子本征求解器(VQE),用参数化ansatz态制备与经典优化循环替代对相干演化要求极高的量子相位估计,大幅降低了对硬件的要求。这篇被引近5000次的论文开创了变分量子算法这一近期量子计算的核心范式。
papers.abstract: Quantum computers promise to efficiently solve important problems that are intractable on a conventional computer. For quantum systems, where the physical dimension grows exponentially, finding the eigenvalues of certain operators is one such intractable problem and remains a fundamental challenge. The quantum phase estimation algorithm efficiently finds the eigenvalue of a given eigenvector but requires fully coherent evolution. Here we present an alternative approach that greatly reduces the requirements for coherent evolution and combine this method with a new approach to state preparation based on ansätze and classical optimization. We implement the algorithm by combining a highly reconfigurable photonic quantum processor with a conventional computer. We experimentally demonstrate the feasibility of this approach with an example from quantum chemistry—calculating the ground-state molecular energy for He–H+. The proposed approach drastically reduces the coherence time requirements, enhancing the potential of quantum resources available today and in the near future. Quantum computers promise to efficiently solve problems that would be practically impossible with a normal computer. Peruzzo et al. develop a variational computation approach that uses any available quantum resources and, with a photonic quantum processing unit, find the ground-state molecular energy of He–H+.

papers.title: Ising formulations of many NP problems
papers.titleZh: 多种NP问题的Ising表述
papers.summaryZh: Andrew Lucas系统给出了Karp的21个NP完全问题以及众多NP难问题(划分、覆盖、可满足性、着色、路径等)到Ising/QUBO模型的映射,每种映射所需自旋数至多为问题规模的三次方。该论文是量子退火与QAOA建模的"字典",几乎所有组合优化问题的量子化都从这里查起,被引超过2500次。
papers.abstract: We provide Ising formulations for many NP-complete and NP-hard problems, including all of Karp's 21 NP-complete problems. This collects and extends mappings to the Ising model from partitioning, covering and satisfiability. In each case, the required number of spins is at most cubic in the size of the problem. This work may be useful in designing adiabatic quantum optimization algorithms.

papers.title: Quantum annealing in the transverse Ising model
papers.titleZh: 横场Ising模型中的量子退火
papers.venue: Physical review. E, Statistical physics, plasmas, fluids, and related interdisciplinary topics
papers.summaryZh: Kadowaki与Nishimori 1998年的开创性工作首次提出"量子退火":在模拟退火的框架中用量子涨落(横场)替代热涨落驱动状态转移,横场随时间衰减类似温度调度。在横场Ising模型上的数值验证表明量子退火比经典模拟退火更快收敛到基态。这一思想直接导向了D-Wave量子退火机的诞生,是整个量子优化硬件路线的理论源头。
papers.abstract: We introduce quantum fluctuations into the simulated annealing process of optimization problems, aiming at faster convergence to the optimal state. Quantum fluctuations cause transitions between states and thus play the same role as thermal fluctuations in the conventional approach. The idea is tested by the transverse Ising model, in which the transverse field is a function of time similar to the temperature in the conventional method. The goal is to find the ground state of the diagonal part of the Hamiltonian with high accuracy as quickly as possible. We have solved the time-dependent Schr\"odinger equation numerically for small size systems with various exchange interactions. Comparison with the results of the corresponding classical (thermal) method reveals that the quantum annealing leads to the ground state with much larger probability in almost all cases if we use the same annealing schedule.

## 论文一：无环图上对称约简 QAOA 表达能力的高效估计

### 一、论文基本信息

| 项目 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **英文标题** | Efficient Estimation of Reduced QAOA Expressibility on Acyclic Graphs |
| **中文标题** | 无环图上对称约简 QAOA 表达能力的高效估计 |
| **作者列表** | Bao Bach, Boris Tsvelikhovskiy, Jose Falla, Ilya Safro（特拉华大学量子优化团队；Safro 教授长期从事量子近似优化算法与经典—量子混合求解器研究） |
| **发表平台** | arXiv 预印本（quant-ph 分类） |
| **arXiv 编号** | 2609.03317（v1，2026-09-03 提交，2026-09-04 随公告公开） |
| **原文链接** | <https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03317> |

### 二、研究背景与动机

量子近似优化算法（QAOA）被视为在近期量子硬件上求解 MaxCut 等组合优化问题最有希望的算法之一，但一个根本性问题是：**给定问题的建模方式，量子电路究竟能"表达"出多大的态空间？** 刻画这一问题的主要工具是由代价哈密顿量与混合哈密顿量生成的动力学李代数（DLA）——DLA 的维度直接决定变分电路的最大表达能力（controllability / expressibility）。然而构造 DLA 需要计算生成元的对易闭包，最坏情况下随比特数指数增长，经典验证在一般图上不可行。

一个反直觉的已知结果是（Tsvelikhovskiy & Safro 等前期工作）：对 MaxCut 这类具有全局 Z₂ 对称的问题，在经典上完全可以**先固定单个顶点的取值**（对称约简）而不改变问题本身，但这一"经典等价"的预处理反而会**显著改变甚至增大**约简后电路的 DLA。换言之，同一个优化问题的不同等价表述，在量子算法下的表达能力与可控性并不等价。这引出本文的核心动机：**能否仅凭图的结构信息，在多项式时间内预测对称约简 QAOA 电路的 DLA 结构与表达能力，从而在投入量子硬件之前先完成"经典可计算性诊断"？**

### 三、核心方法与技术路线

论文聚焦**树（无环图）上的对称约简 QAOA**，给出首个多项式时间的 DLA 结构判定算法，技术路线分三步：

1. **结构判据的建立**：利用树上最短路径的唯一性与顶点度数的奇偶性，将 DLA 维度问题转化为顶点"可分辨性"问题——证明约简后 DLA 是否能区分（resolve）每一个顶点，完全由最短路径结构 + 度奇偶性递归决定，其精神与谱图理论中的 canonical coloring / weighted degree 区分法一脉相承；
2. **多项式算法**：基于该判据给出在树上以多项式时间运行的顶点区分算法；当算法判定所有顶点均可单独分辨时，即可**完全确定**约简 DLA 并认证 ansatz 的最大表达能力；
3. **部分分辨下的保证**：对无法完全区分的顶点集合，算法仍给出严格结论——识别出 DLA 中的嵌入子代数、给出 DLA 维度的严格下界，并认证可控子系统的结构。

### 四、主要实验/理论结果

- **理论结果**：证明了树上对称约简 QAOA 的 DLA 结构可由图结构在多项式时间内完全刻画（完全分辨情形），或给出嵌入子代数 + 维度下界 + 可控子系统认证（部分分辨情形），并验证了此前提出的树判定判据；
- **实验结果**：在随机生成的树与含环图上验证算法的判定能力与效率；观察到顶点分辨程度与实测 DLA 维度 / 可控性的对应关系，确认"经典图结构诊断"与"量子动力学能力"之间的一致性；
- **复杂度对比**：将原本指数级的 DLA 闭包构造（一般图上不可行）在树上降为多项式级，使"上机前表达能力认证"首次成为可扩展的经典计算任务。

### 五、对研究领域的意义与启示

1. **对 QAOA 建模的直接指导**：论文再次证明"经典等价的问题表述 ≠ 等价的量子算法"——对称约简、变量固定、惩罚项改写等经典预处理都会改变量子电路的 DLA 与表达能力。在为组合优化问题设计 QAOA 编码时，应把"表达能力影响"纳入与"比特数、电路深度"同级别的考量；
2. **经典可诊断性工具链**：这是"先经典、后量子"混合研究范式的代表性成果——用多项式时间经典算法为变分量子算法提供上机前认证（表达能力、可控子系统），与昨日主推的 Fourier-LCU（硬件端降深度）形成"经典端验表达力 / 硬件端降复杂度"的互补；
3. **对本团队研究方向的启示**：在构建量子—经典混合优化框架时，可先用此类结构判据筛选"值得量子化"的问题实例与编码方式，再调用 QAOA/退火求解器；树结构结论也有望向稀疏图、分解式求解（如 QAOA-in-QAOA、图分解变分算法）推广，是连接图论结构与量子算法设计的一条清晰路线。

## 论文二：紧凑容错架构在离子阱处理器上的实验验证

### 一、论文基本信息

| 项目 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **英文标题** | Experimental validation of a compact fault-tolerant architecture for trapped ions |
| **中文标题** | 紧凑容错架构在离子阱量子处理器上的实验验证（C₄-Helix 码 / Quantinuum Helios） |
| **作者列表** | Noah Berthusen, Ali Lavasani, Asmae Benhemou, M. S. Allman, Joan Dreiling, Brian Estey, Cameron Foltz, Trent Jacobs, Michael Mills, Annie Jihyun Park, Adam P. Reed, David Hayes, Tzvetan S. Metodi, Andrew C. Potter（Quantinuum 联合学术团队，共 14 人） |
| **发表平台** | arXiv 预印本（quant-ph 分类） |
| **arXiv 编号** | 2609.03194（v1，2026-09-02 提交，2026-09-04 随公告公开） |
| **原文链接** | <https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03194> |

### 二至五、内容简评

量子纠错（QEC）正在使逻辑操作超越未编码的物理操作，但实用的容错计算需要的不只是"低错误量子存储"。本文在 Quantinuum Helios（98 比特离子阱处理器）上实验验证了面向早期容错时代的 [[20,2,6]] C₄-Helix 码容错架构：**每逻辑比特每 QEC 循环错误率低至 4.6×10⁻⁵**；在主动纠错下对单个码块内两个逻辑比特完成完整 Clifford 群基准测试，双比特逻辑 Clifford 错误率 2.8×10⁻⁴；并演示了 C₄-Helix 与码距 5 表面码之间的容错 chain-map 接口，制备出保真度下界 99.925% 的异构三逻辑比特 GHZ 态。所有编码实现均不依赖后选择就全面优于未编码物理基线；电路级模拟显示物理保真度提升后，同一架构可进入 10⁻⁶–10⁻⁸ 的逻辑错误率区间。

意义在于三点：其一，20 个数据比特编码 2 个逻辑比特、码距 6 的**高编码效率**，展示了不同于表面码的紧凑路线（与 IBM 主推的 LDPC 码路线同属"高效率编码"竞争阵营）；其二，论文证明的是**完整容错架构**（编码 + 逻辑操作 + 跨码接口）而非单纯存储，这是迈向通用容错计算的实质性一步；其三，对量子优化领域而言，深层 QAOA/变分电路的可靠执行上限取决于逻辑错误率，此类 10⁻⁵ 量级循环错误率的实验进展，直接决定未来几年"容错量子优化"何时越过多比特深电路的门槛。

## 论文三：Parity Twine——中性原子平台上原子输运、门数与电路深度的联合优化

### 一、论文基本信息

| 项目 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **英文标题** | Optimizing Atom Transport, Gate-Count and Depth with Parity Twine |
| **中文标题** | 用 Parity Twine 联合优化原子输运、门数与电路深度 |
| **作者列表** | Javad Kazemi, Michael Fellner, Riccardo J. Valencia-Tortora, Michael Schuler, Wolfgang Lechner（因斯布鲁克大学 / ParityQC；Lechner 为奇偶架构（LHZ）提出者） |
| **发表平台** | arXiv 预印本（quant-ph 分类） |
| **arXiv 编号** | 2609.03583（v1，2026-09-03 提交，2026-09-04 随公告公开） |
| **原文链接** | <https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03583> |

### 二至五、内容简评

奇偶架构（Parity Architecture）通过把优化问题的自旋-自旋相互作用映射到局域几何比特链，为稀疏连接硬件执行全连接优化问题提供了系统方案，但其核心原语 Parity Trajectory Network（PTN）此前缺少面向真实中性原子硬件的高效实现。本文给出 **PTN 的高效编译器**：可适配任意原子布局、不同原生纠缠门集合（CZ / CZSWAP / iSWAP）以及原子穿梭（shuttling）能力，对编码任意相互作用图的电路进行门数、深度与输运代价的硬件感知联合优化。以量子傅里叶变换（QFT）为例，30 比特 QFT 电路的估计保真度比竞争编译策略**高出三个数量级**，并将方法扩展到 optimistic QFT 设计。

推荐理由：中性原子平台天然适配 Ising 模型与最大独立集等组合优化问题，是量子优化最受关注的硬件路线之一（Pasqal、QuEra 等公司主力方向），而"全连接问题 → 局域几何"的编译代价是该平台跑实用规模 QAOA 的核心瓶颈。这项来自奇偶架构原创团队的工作，把编译层的系统优化做到新高度，对关注硬件落地的研究者是直接的工程参考。

## 一、论文标题（中英文对照）

- **英文标题**：Efficient Fourier-Based Linear Combination of Unitaries and Applications in Quantum Optimization
- **中文标题**：基于傅里叶展开的酉算子线性组合高效方法及其在量子优化中的应用

## 二、作者列表

| 作者 | 简介 |
|------|------|
| Almudena Carrera Vazquez | IBM Quantum 量子算法研究者 |
| Daniel J. Egger | IBM Research Zurich 量子优化方向负责人之一 |
| Stefan Woerner | IBM Research Zurich 量子算法负责人，量子优化领域领军人物（本文通讯作者，v2 由其提交） |

三位作者均来自 **IBM 量子计算研究团队（IBM Quantum / IBM Research – Zurich）**，是当前国际上量子近似优化算法（QAOA）与量子-经典混合优化领域最活跃、最具影响力的工业研究团队之一（团队此前多项工作发表于 *Quantum*、*Nature Computational Science*、*Physical Review Applied* 等，包括著名的 QAOA 温启动方法与量子优化基准库 QuEra/QOBLIB 相关工作）。

## 三、发表平台/期刊名称及时间

- **发表平台**：arXiv 预印本平台（quant-ph 分类）
- **版本时间线**：
  - v1：2026 年 5 月 18 日首次提交
  - **v2（本次推荐版本）：2026 年 9 月 3 日修订，2026 年 9 月 5 日（北京时间）随 arXiv 最新公告正式上线**，修订内容为补充开源代码链接
- **当前状态**：arXiv 预印本（尚未见正式期刊卷期信息，属该团队典型的顶刊/顶会投稿前公开工作）

## 四、arXiv 编号

**arXiv:2605.18985**（v2）
DOI：`10.48550/arXiv.2605.18985`

## 五、研究背景与动机

在含噪中等规模量子（NISQ）时代，QAOA 及其衍生变分量子算法被视为最有可能率先展现量子计算实用价值的方向，尤其面向组合优化问题（MaxCut、投资组合优化、带基数约束的选择问题、调度与路径规划等）。然而这些算法在真实硬件上面临一个核心矛盾：

1. **电路连通性与硬件拓扑不匹配**：组合优化问题的代价哈密顿量通常是全连接或高连通的（例如基数约束罚项、全连接 XY 混合器），编译到只有稀疏连接的量子芯片（如 IBM 的重原子链式拓扑）上会产生极深的电路；
2. **深度即噪声**：电路越深，噪声累积越严重，量子优化的解质量随电路深度迅速退化；
3. **约束处理代价高昂**：带约束组合优化（如投资组合中的基数约束）依赖的惩罚项与约束保持混合器（XY-mixer）恰恰是电路中连通性要求最高的成分；
4. **理论工具缺失**：如何在"近似酉算子"的同时**严格保证优化性能不下滑**，此前缺乏系统化的方法学。

本文的动机正是：**系统地用"多项式级采样开销"换取"大幅降低的电路深度与连通性需求"**，让近期的量子优化算法真正跑得动、跑得深。

## 六、核心方法与技术路线

论文提出**无辅助量子比特的傅里叶线性组合酉算子（Fourier-Based Ancilla-Free LCU）**框架，技术路线可概括为四步：

1. **LCU 近似分解**：将目标酉算子（对角或非对角）展开为一系列"简单酉算子"的线性组合——简单算子只需单比特门层或结构显著简化的子电路即可实现，从而把高度连接的多比特交互替换掉；
2. **傅里叶系数构造**：利用傅里叶级数系统性地产出 LCU 系数，可覆盖广泛类别的对角/非对角酉算子（包括 QAOA 中的约束罚项与全连接 XY 混合器），使分解过程自动化、通用化；
3. **采样式执行与性能保证**：分解后的电路以"近似采样"方式运行——量子优化任务的本质是采样高质量比特串（候选解可经典评估），而无需精确重构全部输出分布。作者证明了这种近似**在与全相干实现对比时保持严格的性能保证**，代价仅为多项式级的采样开销；
4. **量子-经典优化理论的桥接**：论文进一步证明傅里叶型量子罚项与经典数学规划中的**拉格朗日松弛（Lagrangian Relaxation）**存在形式化对应，首次给出"量子约束处理"与"经典约束松弛"的统一视角。

整个框架天然构成**量子-经典混合优化范式**：经典端负责候选解评估与松弛视角，量子端负责高质量解分布的采样。

## 七、主要实验/理论结果

1. **理论结果**：
   - 证明傅里叶 LCU 可高效分解大类的对角与非对角酉算子，将高度连接的量子交互替换为单比特门层，仅引入多项式采样开销；
   - 给出近似采样相对全相干实现的**严格性能保证**（对以"采样优质比特串"为目标的量子优化算法成立）；
   - 建立傅里叶量子罚项 ↔ 拉格朗日松弛的形式化联系，统一了约束处理的量子与经典两种视角。
2. **实验结果**：
   - 12 量子比特电路的**精确态矢量模拟**验证方法正确性与解质量；
   - 在 **106 个超导量子比特**上完成大规模硬件实验（IBM 超导处理器，Heron 级别规模），验证了该方法在真实含噪硬件上对 QAOA 类算法（含基数约束罚项、全连接 XY 混合器）的实际可运行性与可扩展性；
   - 结果表明：以系统化的采样开销换取电路复杂度，可显著扩展近期量子优化的实用边界。

## 八、对本研究领域的意义与启示

1. **对 QAOA/VQA 研究的直接价值**：提供了第一条通向"浅电路 + 约束保持"的系统性路径。对带约束组合优化（基数约束投资组合、调度、路径规划等）而言，这是当前 NISQ 硬件上最具落地性的设计模式之一。
2. **对量子-经典混合优化框架的启示**：论文揭示的"量子罚项 = 拉格朗日松弛"对应关系，为把经典运筹学数十年的约束处理理论（松弛、对偶、罚函数法）整体移植到量子算法设计打开了大门——这正是"量子计算赋能智能优化"的一条清晰技术路线。
3. **对量子退火/绝热方法的互补意义**：LCU-采样范式给出了门模型电路上模拟类似退火式"试探解分布"的低深度方案，与量子退火形成互补。
4. **方法论示范**：106 量子比特的真机验证 + 开源代码，使其成为可复现、可跟进的基准工作；对关注"规模化量子优化实验"的团队有直接参考价值。
5. **对本团队研究方向（量子计算求解组合优化 / 量子赋能智能优化算法）的启示**：在构建混合算法时，应显式管理"电路复杂度—采样开销"的资源权衡；约束型组合优化问题的量子化建模可借鉴本文的傅里叶罚项与松弛视角，并与经典启发式（进化算法、局部搜索）形成三层次混合架构。

| **作者列表** | Maolin Luo（罗茂林，共同一作）、Jiapei Zhuang（庄嘉培，共同一作，通讯作者）、Zuoheng Zou（邹作恒）、Man-Hong Yung |

## 二、研究背景与动机

多目标组合优化（Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization, MOCO）广泛存在于工程设计、物流调度、金融投资与科学发现等领域，需要在相互冲突的目标之间寻找帕累托（Pareto）最优解集。其单目标版本往往已是 NP-hard，多目标化之后难度更高，精确的多目标整数规划求解器随规模增长迅速失效。

目前事实上的标准求解器是 NSGA-II、MOEA/D 等经典进化多目标算法，但它们依赖启发式的交叉与变异算子，缺乏面向问题结构的引导，在巨大组合空间上计算代价高昂。另一方面，以 QAOA（量子近似优化算法）为代表的量子优化工作流几乎都建立在"单目标"或"固定权重标量化"设定之上，缺少面向多目标帕累托前沿的系统方法。

本文动机即在此交汇点上：**利用量子叠加与干涉带来的全局采样多样性，替代进化算法中"生成子代"的环节，加速帕累托前沿覆盖**，同时保留经典进化多目标算法成熟的选择机制，构建 shot（量子测量次数）预算约束下高效的量子-经典混合多目标优化框架。

## 三、核心方法与技术路线

QEMOO（Quantum-Enhanced Multi-Objective Optimization）是一个多轮迭代的量子-经典混合协议，在**总 shot 预算不变**的公平设定下与单轮加权 QAOA 对比。技术路线可概括为四个模块：

1. **标量化分解（量子侧）**：将多目标 Ising 模型按权重池加权求和，分解为一组单目标子问题，交给 QAOA 线路求解，并在子问题之间做**参数迁移（parameter transfer）**以摊薄优化开销。
2. **暖启动 QAOA 采样（量子侧）**：首轮之后，将经典侧筛选出的精英比特串（elite bitstrings）通过**种子自适应的暖启动混合器（seed-adapted warm-start mixers）**注入后续轮次的 QAOA 线路，使量子采样聚焦于有希望的区域——这与进化算法的"精英保留"思想同构。
3. **帕累托选择与方向-种子矩阵（经典侧）**：对累积采样做非支配排序（non-dominated sorting，NSGA-II 式），再由"方向-种子矩阵（Direction-Seed Matrix）"决定下一轮策略，共 9 种组合（S1–S9）：
   - 3 种自适应权重方向更新：Inherit（继承）、Forward（前推）、**PBI 启发自适应**（借鉴 MOEA/D 分解框架中的 Penalty Boundary Intersection）；
   - 3 种种子选择：BC 均衡覆盖（锚点 + 拥挤距离 + 渐进距离阈值）、**HV 贪心排序**（每步选使超体积增量最大的非支配点，与最终评价指标直接对齐）、kNN 稀疏度排序。
4. **评价指标**：以超体积指标（hypervolume）评价最终非支配解集的收敛性与分布性。

整个框架形成"量子采样 → 经典帕累托选择 → 种子注入 → 量子再采样"的闭环，是典型的**量子生成 + 经典选择**混合架构。

## 四、主要实验结果

论文设置了三个难度递进的基准阶段（共约 30 个实例）：

- **小规模网格基准**：态矢量后端（mqvector）精确模拟；
- **大规模网格基准（Grid Large 6×7）**：n=42 自旋、m=71 条边的 5 目标实例，采用矩阵乘积态张量网络后端（mqmps，键维数 χ=30）模拟；
- **强冲突基准（Strong Conflict）**：k=4 目标、n=18、m=60，通过目标间不对称耦合人为构造高度扭曲的权衡结构，专用于压力测试 PBI 启发的自适应标量化。

核心结果：

1. 在相同总 shot 预算下，QEMOO 在三个阶段均**稳定提升帕累托前沿的超体积指标**，全面优于单轮加权 QAOA 基线；
2. PBI 启发的方向自适应更新在目标强冲突、前沿严重扭曲的场景下显著改善覆盖度；
3. 附录系统给出了方法组合热图、权重方向分布影响、混合系数与键维数敏感性、shot 数量影响，以及**量子采样与随机采样的对照**（E 节），证明增益确实来自量子线路而非随机性。

## 五、对研究领域的意义与启示

1. **打通"量子优化"与"进化多目标优化"两个社区**：论文把 NSGA-II 的非支配排序与拥挤距离、MOEA/D 的 PBI 分解、贪心超体积选择等经典 EMO 工具完整移植到以 QAOA 为生成器的混合框架中，为"量子计算赋能智能优化算法"提供了一个可复用的范式模板——量子线路承担"子代生成"，经典进化机制承担"环境选择"。
2. **Shot 预算 = 适应度评估预算**：论文严格的"matched shot budget"对比协议，把量子算法的测量开销与进化算法的评估次数预算放在同一话语体系下讨论，对智能优化背景的研究者非常友好，也为后续"量子算子嵌入 EDA/遗传算法/贝叶斯优化"类研究树立了公平比较的实验规范。
3. **面向 NISQ 的务实路线**：暖启动混合器 + 参数迁移 + 张量网络模拟的工程组合，展示了在不扩大物理比特数的前提下提升解质量与采样效率的可行路径。
4. **可扩展的后续方向**：真实量子硬件验证、与 NSGA-II/MOEA/D 在同预算下的正面对比、约束型 MOCO（如带容量/连通性约束的物流问题）、以及将框架推广到量子退火或其他变分量子算法。

| **发表 / 预印时间** | arXiv v1 提交于 2025-08-12；期刊正式版 2026 年发表 |
| **arXiv 编号** | arXiv:2508.08869 [quant-ph] |
| **DOI** | 10.1038/s43588-026-01007-8 |
| **关键词** | 量子优势 · 标度优势（scaling advantage）· 1-in-3 SAT · NP 完全 · 限制空间约化算法（RSRA）· QAOA / 量子绝热算法 · 超导量子处理器 |

---

## 二、研究背景与动机

**量子优势（quantum advantage）** 是 NISQ（含噪中等规模量子）时代的核心里程碑。但现有"量子优越性"演示（如随机线路采样）针对的是人为构造、无实用价值的问题；而对真正**经典难解（NP 完全）且有用**的组合优化问题，量子算法始终未能展示出对最好经典求解器的优势。在缺乏严格复杂度证明的前提下，论文采用务实的替代判据——**标度优势（scaling advantage）**：随着问题规模增大，量子方法的资源需求增长指数底数若小于最好经典方法，即视为量子优势的经验证据。

论文选取的具体对象是 NP 完全的 **1-in-3 SAT 问题**（每个子句恰好一个文字为真），并在其**相变点 m/n ≈ 0.626**（实例最难的区域）考察求解难度。此前量子优化算法直接作用于这类经典难解问题时从未显示标度优势——这正是本文要打破的局面，切入点不是发明新的量子算法，而是提出一个**经典预处理 + 量子求解的组合增强框架**。

---

## 三、核心方法与技术路线

论文的核心贡献是**限制空间约化算法（Restricting Space Reduction Algorithm, RSRA）**——一个多项式时间的经典预处理步骤，将量子求解器的搜索空间指数级压缩，再在其上"增强"四类成熟量子算法：

### （一）RSRA 三步约化

1. **松弛约束**：把每个子句"恰好一个文字为真"（one-in-three）放松为"真文字个数为奇数"（odd-in-three），得到模 2 线性方程组；经高斯消元得到解空间的**闭式参数化解** x = L·S + T（L 为布尔矩阵、T 为特解向量、S 为自由参数）。搜索空间从 2ⁿ 缩至 2^(n−k)，实测独立方程数 k ≈ m（子句数），即约化到约 **2^(n−m)**；
2. **在缩小空间内还原原问题**：重新施加"恰好一个"条件后，原问题在松弛解空间上自然退化为 **2-SAT 型惩罚项**——每个子句只需惩罚"某两个文字同时为真"；
3. **量子比特减半**：由于新哈密顿量每个子句只涉及两个变量，只需挑选覆盖所有子句的变量子集 G，仅用 **|G| ≈ 0.5n 个量子比特**；其余变量由闭式解唯一恢复。

### （二）保空间量子线路设计

以 |T⟩ 为初态，构造参数化门 G_x(θ, i) = cos(θ/2)·I − i·sin(θ/2)·U_i（其中 U_i 由矩阵 L 的列定义，作用等价于翻转自由参数 S 的第 i 位）——该设计保证**量子态演化始终被限制在松弛解空间内**，从不浪费采样到界外。

### （三）四类增强型量子求解器

| 求解器 | 关键设计 | 标度（指数底 c，m/n=0.626） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **增强 QAOA** | 松弛空间均匀叠加初态 + 保空间 mixer，BFGS 训练 25 层参数 | **1.006ⁿ** |
| **增强 QAA（绝热）** | 同一线路构型，参数由绝热调度函数（两端快、中间慢）确定性给定，100 层；作为 QAOA 性能的下界参照 | **1.008ⁿ** |
| **增强 VQE** | G_x 乘积态 ansatz + Nadam 优化器；可证明**无贫瘠高原**（梯度方差 ≥ 1/32），数值模拟至 n = 150 | — |
| **增强 Grover** | 在约化空间内做振幅放大 | O(√(2^(n−m))) |

---

## 四、主要实验结果

- **标度对比（核心结论）**：在相变点 m/n = 0.626、n 最大至 65 的随机实例上，增强 QAOA（25 层）与增强 QAA（100 层）的难度标度分别为 **1.006ⁿ** 与 **1.008ⁿ**，优于最好经典求解器的 **1.013ⁿ**（基线：MiniSAT、Glucose、Lingeling、Cadical、DLX，取平均冲突数拟合）——这是量子方法对 NP 完全问题的首个经验性标度优势证据；
- **优势完全来自 RSRA**：不加约化的原始 QAOA / QAA 标度仅 1.039ⁿ / 1.041ⁿ，Grover 1.345ⁿ，增强 VQE 1.020ⁿ——均不敌最好经典基线；
- **代价度量协议**：量子侧以平均成功概率的指数衰减率（即重复运行次数）拟合 cⁿ，经典侧以 SAT 竞赛标准的平均冲突数拟合，均对 n 做对数线性回归；层数固定时每层线路代价仅多项式增长；
- **硬件验证（13 比特超导 transmon 处理器，可调耦合器）**：
  - 8 变量实例上，增强 VQE / QAOA 成功概率分别达 **43.04% / 36.40%**，而非增强版本能量停留在 3.5 以上、成功率近乎为零；
  - 13 比特全使用的单层增强 QAOA 在 n = 5–20 共 10 组规模实例上稳定优于"松弛空间内随机猜测"基线；标准 QAOA 在 n = 20 时已无有效输出；
- **模拟规模**：VQE 至 n = 150，QAOA/QAA 至 n = 100，经典对照至 n = 120（各规模数千实例）。

---

## 五、对研究领域的意义与启示

1. **首个对 NP 完全问题的量子标度优势证据**：在没有复杂度证明可期的现实下，"标度优势"作为可实测的替代判据被系统性落地，为量子优化领域提供了新的实证范式与实验评估规范；
2. **"经典约化 + 量子受限空间搜索"的通用增强层**：RSRA 的价值在于它是**算法无关的预处理层**——同一约化同时增强了 QAOA、QAA、VQE、Grover 四条技术路线，且把所需量子比特砍半。这一"空间限制"思想可推广至其他约束满足 / 组合优化问题，是比单一算法改进更重要的方法论贡献；
3. **诚实的自我定位与可商榷之处**：作者明确声明结论是经验性而非复杂度证明；且量子侧（成功概率→重复次数）与经典侧（冲突数）使用**不同源的代价代理指标**、回归窗口对各求解器截断点不同、限定正文字 1-in-3 SAT（保证松弛后可满足）——这些边界条件是该结论能否外推的关键，阅读时应予以注意；
4. **对智能优化方向的启示**：松弛-约化-再求解的三段式与"把启发式先验注入量子初态 / 线路结构"（保空间门设计）一脉相承，为量子-经典混合优化提供了"先压缩搜索空间、再量子采样"的通用模板；
5. **国内团队的旗舰级成果**：清华大学联合北京量子信息科学研究院登上 Nature Computational Science 封面，对国内量子计算社区具有标志意义。

# 每日论文推荐 | 2026-09-02 · 量子计算求解组合优化

> 检索范围：arXiv quant-ph 当日（2026-09-02）最新公告 143 条（新提交 50 + 交叉列表 25 + 更新 68），并通过 OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar 交叉核验。当日量子优化方向共筛选出 4 篇候选，本文为其中最具代表性的一篇。

---

## 一、论文基本信息

| 项目 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **英文标题** | A Backend-Agnostic MWIS Kernel for Stochastic Unit Commitment with Neutral-Atom Hardware Validation |
| **中文译名** | 面向随机机组组合的后端无关最大权独立集（MWIS）内核：中性原子量子硬件验证 |
| **作者列表** | Jiying Chen（剑桥大学，通讯作者）、Min Lin、Jingwei Wen（中国移动（苏州）软件技术有限公司）、Zhihong Zhang（中国移动（苏州）软件技术有限公司）、Chuixiong Wu（太一量子科技（上海）有限公司，通讯作者） |
| **发表平台** | arXiv 预印本（quant-ph 主分类，交叉 cs.ET 电子工程、math.OC 运筹优化）；暂未见期刊录用信息 |
| **提交/发布时间** | 2026-09-01 13:46 UTC 提交，2026-09-02（美东时间周三）在 arXiv 公告 |
| **arXiv 编号** | 2609.01248 |
| **论文原文链接** | <https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01248> |

---

## 二、研究背景与动机

**领域背景**：组合优化被认为是近期含噪中等规模量子（NISQ）硬件最有希望率先落地的应用方向，QAOA、量子退火、模拟量子退火（AHS）等路线均在积极探索。但该方向存在两大长期痛点：其一，真实工业运筹模型（含连续变量与复杂约束）难以直接编译为量子硬件可执行的伊辛/QUBO 形式；其二，噪声量子硬件输出的解质量差，缺乏与真实决策回路对接的可行解修复机制。

**具体问题**：本文聚焦电力系统与绿氢工业中的经典 NP-hard 问题——**机组组合（Unit Commitment, UC）**：在满足功率平衡、储氢罐动力学等约束下，决定各电解槽模块每个时段的开/关机状态并优化连续调度量。作者以一个 6 模块绿氢电解槽园区为对象，在随机风光出力场景下求解 24 小时随机 UC。即便仅考虑离散开关变量，6 模块 × 24 时段的搜索空间也高达 2¹⁴⁴ ≈ 2.2×10⁴³，且随机版本需覆盖 100 个场景。

**研究空白**：既往量子 UC 工作几乎全部基于 D-Wing 量子退火机 + QUBO 编码 + 外层线性规划（LP）；而快速崛起的中性原子平台（如 QuEra Aquila，原生支持 Rydberg 阻塞即 unit-disk 图的最大独立集求解）此前仅在 ≤12 顶点的 MaxCut 教学级实例上验证过——既没有 UC 级工业问题的编码方案，也没有与真实调度回路闭环的修复流程。本文正是要填补这一空白。

---

## 三、核心方法与技术路线

论文提出一套**六阶段量子-经典混合流水线**，核心思想是把"量子可解的最大权独立集（MWIS）"作为后端无关的中间表示（IR），将量子求解器降级为可插拔组件：

1. **参考调度生成**：用经典启发式（chronological fill 等）构造初始调度。
2. **移动算子（move）生成**：定义 6 类邻域扰动算子——单槽退commit、连续 4 小时块退commit、跨模块对交换、k-模块交换、删除/插入、聚类整数邻域调整，每个 move 表示"对参考调度的一次局部改进"。
3. **LP 对偶定价（编译关键）**：对参考调度解一次 100 场景随机 LP（HiGHS 求解器），提取功率平衡约束与储氢罐动力学约束的影子价格 λ^C5、λ^C7，用闭式公式为每个 move 打分。实验证明该对偶定价的排序质量远优于"电价代理"（符号一致率提升 35 个百分点）。
4. **多样性剪枝**：保留 top-k（k=50）move。
5. **冲突图 MWIS 求解（后端无关内核）**：move = 节点，LP 对偶分 = 权重，共享同一 (模块, 时段) 槽位的 move 互连边。同一张图可无损交付给三类后端——HiGHS MILP（精确基线）、QuEra Aquila 中性原子 AHS（本文重点）、D-Wave 量子退火/相干伊辛机 CIM（QUBO 转换），构成"编译一次、后端任意"的架构。
6. **硬件嵌入与脉冲方案**：Aquila 的 King 图（8 邻域）天然匹配 unit-disk 冲突图；24 时段超出其 75×76 µm 视场，采用"双行折叠"技术（按最小分割点对折），实现**零辅助原子**开销；设计窄零穿越退火脉冲（Ω=8 MHz，全局失谐 −30→+30 MHz，局域失谐峰 −125 MHz，T=4 µs），节点权重经局域失谐编码。
7. **经典修复与金标准验证**：硬件输出经 4 相后处理（断边冲突消解 → 独立集强制 → 负权剪枝 → 贪心增广）后作为模拟退火（SA）的热启动种子，最终解再经 100 场景随机 LP 修复，验证可行性并计算真实调度收益。

---

## 四、主要实验结果

- **15 天真实硬件滚动实验**（QuEra Aquila，经 AWS Braket 云端访问，每天 50 节点、200 shots）：后处理的 AHS 输出平均保持精确 MWIS 目标值的 **94.0%**（区间 74.8%–100%），全部通过 0.60 的可用性阈值——这是迄今中性原子平台上最大规模工业优化实例的持续验证。
- **端到端调度收益**：AHS+SA 管线在 **15 天全部 ≥ 精确 MWIS+LP 经典基线**（日均收益 £12,458 vs £12,358，其中 4 天高出 2.9%–11.6%）。作者诚实指出：超额收益源于 LP 代理目标与真实目标的部分错配，而非量子加速。
- **规模扩展规律（N=50→144）**：编码质量保持稳定（0.881–0.950），但有效采样率（有效 shot 占比）从 0.720 坍缩至 N=100 的 0.095、N=144 回升至 0.245——证明**逐 shot 有效性而非视场尺寸才是当前规模化瓶颈**；反推单原子保留率为 0.977–0.994，与设备 ~0.995^N 的排序保真度界一致。
- **编码理论分析**：N=12 精确对角化显示 MWIS 最优解仅对应哈密顿量谱中的 rank-3 激发态（非基态），绝热编码窗口仅约 200 ns，而 T=2–6 µs 的性能不敏感性印证了"窄零穿越 + 深失谐"脉冲的鲁棒性。
- **开源**：全流程代码与 15 天硬件数据已开源（github.com/Cambridge-EQ/mwis-uc-kernel）。

---

## 五、对研究领域的意义与启示

1. **首个工业级端到端闭环**：这是首个将真实工业调度决策（绿氢园区机组组合）经可插拔 MWIS 中间表示端到端接入可编程中性原子硬件的工作，从"玩具 MaxCut"跨入"运维决策"。
2. **后端无关架构的范式价值**：LP 对偶定价 + 冲突图 IR + 经典修复的"编译层"设计，使 AHS、量子退火、伊辛机、经典 MILP 在同一框架下可互换——为量子-经典混合优化框架的系统设计提供了直接模板。
3. **诚实的评估方法论**：作者明确声明实例对经典求解器仍是"易解"的（HiGHS <1 s），本文测量的是"工业修复回路中的流水线保真度"而非量子加速——这种清醒的自我定位在量子优化文献中难得，可作为实验评估规范的参照。
4. **对规模化的定量认知**：给出"全阵列后选择成功率 v = p^N"的算术框架，把中性原子硬件做组合优化的真实工程边界（逐 shot 有效性、原子保留率、视场折叠）量化到可预测的程度。
5. **对智能优化研究者的启示**：move-based 邻域搜索与 MWIS 编译的组合、量子采样作为 SA 热启动种子、代理目标与真实目标的错配甚至可转化为搜索多样性优势——均为"量子赋能智能优化算法"提供了具体可借鉴的接口设计。

---

## 六、当日候选论文对比（筛选说明）

| arXiv 编号 | 标题要点 | 未入选原因 |

| 2609.00881 | 量子引导 MIS 求解天然气合约选择（QOBLIB 基准，平均近似比 0.996） | 方法框架相似，但无真实硬件持续验证 |
| 2609.00825 | QAOA 优化天然气管网输量（IonQ Forte-1 实机，p=2） | 规模较小（7 页），工程深度不及入选论文 |
| 2609.01280 | QAOA 梯度响应的动力学区域 | 偏可训练性理论，应用面较窄 |

**入选理由**：今日所有候选中唯一同时具备"真实硬件 15 天持续验证 + 工业级随机 UC 问题 + 后端无关混合框架 + 剑桥大学/中国移动/太一量子多方团队 + 全流程开源"的工作，横跨量子退火、AHS、量子-经典混合框架多个关注方向。

---

| **发表 / 更新时间** | PRA 于 **2026-08-03 在线发表**（2025-12-30 收稿）；arXiv 版本历史：v1 2025-09-23 → v2 2026-02-20 → **v3 2026-08-28 修订**（随 2026-08-31 批次公告，为本次检索时点可见的最新更新） |
| **arXiv 编号** | arXiv:2509.19035 [quant-ph] |
| **DOI** | 10.1103/x32d-wx13（Physical Review A） |
| **文档规模** | 13 页，7 幅图 |

## 二、研究背景与动机

**量子近似优化算法（QAOA）** 是 NISQ（含噪中等规模量子）时代求解组合优化问题的旗舰候选算法：将 QUBO / Ising 形式的组合优化问题映射为代价哈密顿量，通过交替施加代价层与混合层并测量比特串来搜索高质量近似解。然而，QAOA 走向实用化面临两个相互纠缠的开销瓶颈：

1. **采样开销**：量子线路每次执行只产生一个比特串样本，且测量结果具有随机性。要以高概率找到达到目标近似比（approximation ratio）的解，通常需要重复执行线路大量次数（shots），且所需 shots 一般随问题规模增长——运行时间被采样过程主导，可能抵消量子计算带来的任何加速；
2. **逐实例参数优化开销**：QAOA 的角度参数需针对每个具体问题实例进行训练，量子-经典混合优化循环需要大量线路评估，代价高昂且难以规模化。

本文的动机正是**同时消除这两类开销**：提出并系统验证一种"固定参数 QAOA（fixed-parameter QAOA, fpQAOA）"协议，证明在完全免除逐实例优化的前提下，达到目标近似比所需的采样次数可以做到**与问题规模无关的有效常数**。

## 三、核心方法与技术路线

fpQAOA 协议由三项关键要素构成：

1. **正弦-余弦角度编码（sin-cos angle encoding）**：将 QUBO 实例的耦合系数经 **QUBO 矩阵 Frobenius 范数归一化** 后，以正弦/余弦角度的形式编码进 QAOA 代价算符，使角度取值的分布与问题规模无关（幅值有界），这是实现参数跨规模迁移的关键组件；
2. **小规模训练 + 跨规模参数迁移**：仅在少数量子比特的小规模实例上训练 QAOA 参数，随后将参数**直接迁移**到更大的问题实例，完全免除对每个新实例的重新优化——参数与问题规模解耦；
3. **常数级采样复杂度**：参数固定后，单一量子线路构型输出的比特串分布即以高概率包含高质量近似解，从而将所需 shots 压缩为与问题规模无关的常数。

技术验证上，作者通过**消融实验（ablation study）** 逐项检验各组件贡献：移除角度编码后，所需 shots 随问题规模显著增长——证明角度编码是采样复杂度保持常数的最关键因素。整个评估在无噪声数值模拟中完成，并对单次 shot 的线路门数与运行时间代价进行了独立分析。

## 四、主要实验结果

- **规模与质量**：在无噪声数值模拟中，对随机生成的 QUBO 实例测试至 **30 量子比特**，以高概率找到**近似比 ≥ 0.95** 的解；
- **核心结论**：在该规模范围内，达到目标近似比所需的测量次数（shots）保持**有效常数**——即采样复杂度不随问题规模增长；
- **消融验证**：移除角度编码后，shot 复杂度随问题规模增长，确认角度编码是常数采样复杂度的决定性组件；
- **代价转移分析**：虽然 shots 为常数，但单次 shot 线路中单量子比特旋转门数量随规模呈**多项式级**增长，单次 shot 的运行时间按 **O(N³)** 规模化——总开销从"采样次数"转移至"单次线路执行代价"；
- **适用前提**：全部结果基于无噪声模拟假设，噪声硬件上的表现留待后续验证。

## 五、对研究领域的意义与启示

1. **直击 QAOA 实用化两大痛点**：采样开销与逐实例参数训练是 QAOA 可扩展性讨论中被广泛承认却少有系统性解法的难题，本文给出"角度编码 + 参数迁移"的组合式解法并完成了消融归因，方法学上完整扎实；
2. **"免重训练"范式的示范**："小规模训练、大规模迁移"的思路与经典智能优化领域中"离线学习超参数 / 学习到优化（learning-to-optimize）"的思想同构，为**量子计算赋能智能优化算法**提供了可借鉴的跨规模泛化设计范式——其中 Frobenius 范数归一化实现"问题规模无关的特征缩放"这一细节，对任何需要参数迁移的混合算法设计都有直接启发；
3. **量子优势论证的重新校准**：结论表明 QAOA 的运行时间瓶颈可从"指数级/线性增长的测量次数"转移为"多项式级增长的单 shot 门数与 O(N³) 线路执行时间"，为后续量子优势的理论论证划定了更清晰的靶子；
4. **清醒的局限意识**：作者明确指出结果限于无噪声模拟，诚实的代价转移分析（O(N³) per-shot time）为该方向的后续硬件实验提供了明确的检验基线；
5. **发表信号**：论文经 Physical Review A 严格评审后正式见刊，并在见刊后持续以 v3 修订维护，反映其在 QAOA 可扩展性方向被认可的参考价值（昨日报告的备选池中亦收录本篇，今日正式推荐）。

# 每日论文精选报告 —— 量子优化方向（2026-08-31）

## 一、论文基本信息

| 项目 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| **英文标题** | Energy Internet Routing using Quantum Optimization Algorithms |
| **中文标题** | 基于量子优化算法的能源互联网路由 |
| **作者列表** | Alireza Alamgir Tehrani, Mehrdad Boroushaki, Abbas Rajabi |
| **发表平台** | arXiv 预印本平台（quant-ph 分类）；论文备注"拟投稿至 *Quantum* 期刊"（for submission to the Quantum journal） |
| **提交 / 发布时间** | 2026-08-28（UTC）提交，2026-08-31（周一）arXiv 正式发布列出 |
| **arXiv 编号** | arXiv:2608.28401 [quant-ph] |
| **DOI** | 10.48550/arXiv.2608.28401（DataCite 注册中） |
| **文档规模** | 16 页，5 幅图 |
| **许可协议** | CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 |

## 二、研究背景与动机

**能源互联网（Energy Internet, EI）** 是为实现可再生能源与电网深度融合而提出的新一代能源系统架构。在 EI 中，能量以"数据包"式的形式在网络节点间路由传输，其核心运筹问题之一是**能效最优路径选择（energy-efficient path selection）**——在满足需求的前提下，选择传输损耗最小、能效最高的能量路由方案。该问题被证明是 **NP-hard** 的：随着网络规模增长，经典精确算法的计算代价急剧上升。

在"双碳"目标与高比例可再生渗透的背景下，该问题的规模与实时性要求不断提高，传统方法（如 Dijkstra 最短路径算法、数学规划求解器）在大规模、多约束场景下面临可扩展性瓶颈。量子计算——尤其是**量子退火（Quantum Annealing）**与**量子近似优化算法（QAOA）**——为组合优化问题提供了新的求解范式：将路径选择问题映射为 QUBO / Ising 模型后，可借助量子硬件或量子启发式求解器进行搜索。本文正是这一思路在能源互联网路由场景中的系统性落地与实证评估。

## 三、核心方法与技术路线

本文的技术路线遵循"**问题建模 → 量子映射 → 多求解器验证 → 经典-量子对比**"的完整闭环：

1. **QUBO / Ising 哈密顿量建模**：提出一种面向能源路由的创新性二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）与 Ising 哈密顿量数学表达，将 EI 中能量高效路径选择问题编码为量子优化硬件可直接处理的能量最小化形式；
2. **量子门电路优化（QAOA 路线）**：基于 Qiskit 框架的 **Sampler Primitive** 实现 QAOA 求解，并使用 **NumPyEigenSolver** 作为基准特征值求解器；
3. **量子退火 / 量子启发式路线（D-Wave 生态）**：使用 Ocean 工具链中的 **Exact Solver（精确求解器）**、**Tabu Sampler（禁忌搜索采样器）** 与 **Simulated Annealing（模拟退火采样器）** 求解同一 QUBO 模型；
4. **经典基线对比**：以 **Dijkstra 算法**及基于数学规划的优化方法作为经典参照，形成系统的量子-经典混合对比评估框架；
5. **案例研究**：在 **9 节点**与 **30 节点**两个能源互联网测试网络上验证模型的正确性与可扩展性。

## 四、主要实验结果

- **正确性**：基于所提 QUBO/Ising 模型，各量子（及量子启发）求解方法的仿真结果与精确解（Exact Solver）**完全一致**，验证了建模的正确性；
- **性能对比**：在当前规模下，**经典方法（Dijkstra 等）的运行时间仍短于量子方法**——这一诚实的负面结果对领域内的"量子优势"预期具有重要的校准意义；
- **量子方法内部**：**D-Wave 模拟退火采样器（Simulated Annealing）** 在所有量子类方法中运行时间最短，说明在 NISQ 时代，量子启发式退火方法在实用性上先于门电路 QAOA；
- **可扩展性**：9 节点 → 30 节点的规模扩展实验表明所提建模方法具备进一步放大的潜力。

## 五、对研究领域的意义与启示

1. **应用领域拓展**：这是量子组合优化技术在**能源互联网/智能电网**这一国家重大基础设施场景的较新落地工作，为"量子计算赋能行业优化"提供了从建模到求解的完整参考模板；
2. **建模方法论价值**：论文给出的能源路由 QUBO/Ising 形式化表达，可复用于能源调度、网架规划、电力市场出清等相邻 NP-hard 问题，是"实际问题 → 量子模型"转化的范例；
3. **量子-经典公平对比范式**：论文同时使用 QAOA（门电路路线）与量子退火（D-Wave 路线）并诚实地报告经典方法在运行时间上的优势，为 NISQ 时代"量子何时真正有用"提供了清醒的实证参照；
4. **对混合框架研究的启示**：结果显示模拟退火等量子启发方法当前最具实用价值，提示近期研究应更多关注"经典预处理 + 量子启发搜索 + 浅层 QAOA 精修"的混合优化架构，而非单纯追求全量子求解。

items.title: IBM 实现约 70 个逻辑比特的容错计算里程碑
items.summary: IBM 在 8 月底公布:采用新的低密度奇偶校验(LDPC)码纠错策略,在量子处理器上编码约 70 个逻辑比特,并完成一个经典上不可解问题的演示。该公司正推进 2029 年 Starling 容错处理器路线图(200 比特、1 亿门规模),纠错路线从表面码转向 LDPC 是其核心差异点。逻辑比特规模是衡量量子优化算法能否摆脱噪声的关键指标,该进展对优化领域意义重大。

items.title: Quantinuum 完成 2026 年最大量子 IPO,并登陆 Oracle 云
items.summary: Honeywell 系的 Quantinuum 于 6 月完成约 16.8 亿美元 IPO,成为 2026 年量子行业最大上市事件。其 Helios 离子阱系统(98 比特、高门保真度)被视为当前最完整的量子系统之一;公司与 Oracle 合作把量子计算接入 Oracle 云基础设施,路线图目标 2026 年实现 100+ 逻辑比特、2027 年 192 个。离子阱全连接架构对 QAOA 类算法具有天然适配性,其商业化节奏值得持续关注。

items.title: IonQ 创下 99.99% 两比特门保真度纪录,Q2 营收 8010 万美元
items.summary: IonQ 报告 2026 年 Q2 营收 8010 万美元,并宣布实现 99.99% 两比特门保真度——为各大主流平台公开指标中的最高值(Quantinuum 约 99.92%)。公司目标 2027 年实现 800 个逻辑比特,硬件已接入 AWS、Google Cloud 与 Azure 三大云。门保真度直接决定深层变分优化电路的可靠执行上限,这一指标竞赛与量子优化的实用性时间表强相关。

items.title: Pasqal 交付 140 比特中性原子量子系统
items.summary: 法国中性原子公司 Pasqal 交付了 140 比特中性原子量子系统。中性原子阵列凭借天然适配 Ising 模型与最大独立集等组合优化问题、可扩展至千比特级,是量子优化最受关注的平台之一;此次交付标志着该平台从实验室走向用户现场部署。

items.title: D-Wave 聚焦企业级量子应用部署,预订量大幅增长
items.summary: D-Wave 在 Q2 2026 财报中报告预订量大幅增长(含面向德国 FAU 的约 3000 万美元系统销售),公司战略明确聚焦"量子赋能应用"的落地部署——通过 Advantage2 退火系统与混合求解器服务制造、物流、金融等行业客户。退火路线在组合优化上的商业化进展是观察量子优化实用化的最直接窗口。

items.title: 谷歌 Willow 芯片持续推进表面码纠错路线
items.summary: 谷歌继续推进 Willow 芯片的表面码纠错研究——此前 Willow 首次演示了随码距增大错误率指数下降的"低于阈值"纠错。表面码与 LDPC 码两条路线的竞争,决定了未来五年容错量子优化算法的可得性;同时谷歌圣巴巴拉量子园区正扩建以支撑下一代超导芯片研发。

items.title: 意大利与加拿大深化量子科技合作
items.summary: 9 月 3 日,意大利与加拿大宣布深化量子科技合作,包括与滑铁卢大学等机构的联合研究计划。国际间的量子科研协作与人才流动持续加强,欧洲-北美量子生态的联动为量子优化算法研究提供了更多跨国合作机会。

items.title: QuIC、Atom Computing、Qilimanjaro 宣布多项高管任命
items.source: Quantum Computing Report(9 月 5 日)
items.summary: 据 Quantum Computing Report 9 月 5 日 "Who's News" 栏目,量子产业联盟 QuIC 任命 Cécile Perrault 为新任执行董事,Atom Computing 与西班牙超导量子计算公司 Qilimanjaro Quantum Tech 亦同期宣布战略级人事任命。周末行业面平静、无重大硬件发布,多家人气企业的高管到位预示着四季度产业布局加速,值得关注后续融资与交付节奏。
